context_requirements: Functional mu/delta/kappa opioid receptor expression on the assayed cell line
Gi/o-coupled signaling competent to modulate cAMP/PKA and MAPK
A transcriptional output program downstream of opioid receptor activation, which is generally weak or absent in these lines
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h across multiple cell lines
Shared transcriptional signature across the nine lines that is reversed by a selective opioid receptor antagonist
Enrichment of cAMP-responsive or MAPK-responsive gene sets after treatment
